columns.name: RENDITION_ID
columns.description: System generated unique identifier.

columns.name: CONTENT_ID
columns.description: Parent/video content entity id.

columns.name: DESCRIPTOR
columns.description: Descriptor of the video rendition.

columns.name: PLAYLIST
columns.description: Play-list information of the video rendition.

columns.name: LOCATION
columns.description: External storage source URL for the video rendition.

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_SEGMENTS
columns.description: Number of segments/chunks in the video rendition.

columns.name: DURATION
columns.description: The duration of the video rendition in seconds.

columns.name: FRAME_WIDTH
columns.description: Frame width in pixels of the video rendition.

columns.name: FRAME_HEIGHT
columns.description: Frame height in pixels of the video rendition.

columns.name: VIDEO_PROTOCOL
columns.description: Protocol of the video rendition.

columns.name: VIDEO_FORMAT
columns.description: Format of the video rendition.

columns.name: VIDEO_CODEC
columns.description: Codec of the video rendition.

columns.name: VIDEO_BITRATE
columns.description: Bit-rate of the video rendition.

columns.name: FRAME_RATE
columns.description: Frame rate in fps of the video rendition.

columns.name: AUDIO_FORMAT
columns.description: Audio format of the video rendition.

columns.name: AUDIO_CODEC
columns.description: Audio codec of the video rendition.

columns.name: AUDIO_BITRATE
columns.description: Audio bit-rate in kbps of the video rendition.

columns.name: AUDIO_CHANNELS
columns.description: Number of audio channels of the video rendition.

columns.name: AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE
columns.description: Audio sample rate in Hz of the video rendition.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
